name: Modelence

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: 1 production instance included (size not stated); $20/mo App Builder (LLM) credits, not compute. The pricing page lists 'On-demand cloud usage' only under Pro.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Unlimited production instances, multi-region deployments, custom SLAs.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Prototyping: one-time $5 App Builder (LLM) credit, managed databases, modelence.app subdomain. No production instance included.

caveats: Free prototype; Starter $20/mo includes 1 production instance; Pro $100 includes 5. App Builder $20/$100 credits are LLM credits, not compute credit. Containers 4/8 $0.24/h, 4/16 $0.28/h; included-instance shape not explicit so total cannot be accurately netted. Hourly charges stop when environment stopped.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

fleet.tiers: Starter includes 1 production instance; Pro includes 5 and on-demand cloud usage; Enterprise custom.
fleet.notes: Included production instances are plan allowances, not proven maximum concurrent machines. Free prototyping does not publish a clear running-instance fleet cap, quota-increase SLA or verification requirements.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

secret_proxy.quote: Any variables the user defines in the dashboard under Environment variables.
secret_proxy.note: Secrets are environment variables / typed config values of type 'secret' (masked, write-only in the dashboard) injected into the running container at start. No credential-injecting proxy. App Builder LLM usage is paid via platform credits (keys not exposed to user).

isolation.quote: A Docker image built from the repository on an official Node.js image, 18 or newer
isolation.note: Modelence Cloud runs each app as a Docker container built from source; not a VM/microVM product.

image_oci.quote: A Docker image built from the repository on an official Node.js image, 18 or newer (default node-22-slim, set with image).
image_oci.note: The platform builds the container image from the repository's build/start commands; there is no option to push/start from a user-supplied OCI/Docker image.

docker_inside.quote: It needs Docker Compose or a custom Dockerfile to run.
docker_inside.note: Listed as a reason a project is NOT compatible with Modelence Cloud, implying no Docker-in-Docker / Compose support inside the managed container.

nested_virt.quote: Pay only for what you use, based on the number and tier of your app containers
nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a single-process Node.js app container with no documented /dev/kvm or virtualization support.

desktop.quote: Modelence is a full-stack framework for building and running production web applications, with built-in authentication, database setup, scheduled jobs, monitoring and more.
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope (a Node.js/MongoDB app-hosting PaaS, not a desktop/VM environment).

browser.quote: Modelence is a full-stack framework for building and running production web applications, with built-in authentication, database setup, scheduled jobs, monitoring and more.
browser.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; no managed/embedded browser instance is provided.

computer_use.quote: Modelence is a full-stack framework for building and running production web applications, with built-in authentication, database setup, scheduled jobs, monitoring and more.
computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope.

anti_bot.quote: Modelence is a full-stack framework for building and running production web applications, with built-in authentication, database setup, scheduled jobs, monitoring and more.
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope.

captcha_solving.quote: Modelence is a full-stack framework for building and running production web applications, with built-in authentication, database setup, scheduled jobs, monitoring and more.
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope.

ssh.quote: One web process, started with the resource's start commands... You can view logs, metrics, and manage your deployment from the Modelence Cloud dashboard.
ssh.note: No SSH/shell access to the running container is documented; interaction is via the CLI deploy tool and dashboard (logs/metrics/env vars) only.

snapshot.quote: npx modelence deploy ... Build your application / Upload it to Modelence Cloud / Provision necessary resources / Start your application
snapshot.note: Containers are rebuilt from source on each deploy; no disk or memory snapshot/restore feature is documented anywhere on the site or docs.

snapshot_auto.quote: Build your application / Upload it to Modelence Cloud / Provision necessary resources / Start your application

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Build your application / Upload it to Modelence Cloud / Provision necessary resources / Start your application

fork.quote: Pay only for what you use, based on the number and tier of your app containers
fork.note: No machine-cloning feature documented; scaling is done by choosing a container tier/count, not by forking a running instance.

fork_running.quote: Pay only for what you use, based on the number and tier of your app containers

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: Pay only for what you use, based on the number and tier of your app containers

pause_resume.quote: There is no commitment - you only accrue charges while your deployment is running, on an hourly basis. You can immediately stop or adjust your environment at any time.
pause_resume.note: Environments can be stopped (billing stops) and started again from the dashboard; not explicitly termed 'pause', but functionally billing-paused stop/resume.

wake_on_request.quote: Every deployment includes automatic SSL certificates, load balancing, auto-scaling and built-in observability.
wake_on_request.note: "Auto-scaling" refers to scaling replicas under load, not waking a stopped environment on an incoming request; no wake-on-request behavior is documented.

persistent_disk.quote: Upload and manage files with Modelence Cloud storage
persistent_disk.note: A separate managed file-storage feature exists precisely because the running container's local filesystem is not documented as persistent across restarts/redeploys; app state is expected to live in MongoDB or the Files service.

volume_attach.note: No attachable-volume concept in the deploy config or dashboard docs.

auto_stop_idle.quote: There is no commitment - you only accrue charges while your deployment is running, on an hourly basis.
auto_stop_idle.note: Billing is continuous per-hour while the environment is running; no idle-based auto-stop/sleep is documented (stopping is a manual user action).

live_resize.quote: You can adjust the number of containers and their tier immediately from your dashboard at any time.
live_resize.note: Container count and tier (vCPU/RAM size) can be changed immediately from the dashboard without a stated redeploy/recreate step.

agent_harnesses.quote: Set up Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to build Modelence apps locally
agent_harnesses.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the Claude Code/Cursor/Codex integration is for local development tooling (a docs MCP server + plugin) to help write Modelence apps, not a coding-agent preinstalled/offered as a template inside a hosted sandbox.

harness_api.quote: Set up Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to build Modelence apps locally
harness_api.note: No first-party API to drive a coding harness inside a Modelence-hosted sandbox is documented.

own_agent_api.quote: Describe the app you want to build - Submit your prompt - the App Builder will generate and deploy your app.
own_agent_api.note: The App Builder is a prompt-to-app code generator (paid via LLM credits), not a browser/computer-use/research task agent with a first-party driving API.

mcp_server.quote: claude mcp add --transport http modelence https://cloud.modelence.com/mcp ... The same server is available at https://cloud.modelence.com/mcp for tools ... grants access to every app in your organization
mcp_server.note: Modelence ships an authenticated MCP server (cloud.modelence.com/mcp) that reads/manages a user's deployed apps/environments, plus a separate docs-only MCP server.

lang_python.quote: It is not a Node.js application — Java, Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, .NET and so on, even with a Node.js frontend in front. The image runs Node.js only.
lang_python.note: Explicitly Node.js-only runtime; Python apps are stated as incompatible.

public_ipv4.quote: SITE_URL and ROOT_URL — the environment's public URL (both hold the same value).
public_ipv4.note: Apps are reached via a platform-issued/custom-domain URL behind Modelence's load balancing, not a dedicated public IPv4 per container.

ingress_rules.note: Only custom-domain routing is documented; no IP allowlisting, private/auth URLs, or security-group style ingress control for exposed ports is documented.

egress_allowlist.note: No outbound allow/deny list, no-internet mode, or security-group egress rules are documented.

egress_http_rules.note: No HTTP method/path-level egress rule feature is documented.

guest_firewall.quote: A Docker image built from the repository on an official Node.js image
guest_firewall.note: derived: isolation is container (shared-kernel Docker), not a full VM/microVM with guest root, so nftables/iptables control inside is not implied.

static_egress_ip.note: No fixed/static outbound IP feature is documented.

gpu.quote: Size vCPU Memory Price ... Micro 0.25 0.5 GB ... X-Large Plus 4 16 GB
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — pricing lists only CPU/RAM container tiers, no GPU option.

windows.quote: A Docker image built from the repository on an official Node.js image
windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Linux-based Node.js Docker images only.

macos.quote: A Docker image built from the repository on an official Node.js image
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Linux container hosting only.

self_host.quote: Cloud deployments include automatic scaling, monitoring, and a production-ready MongoDB database. You can view logs, metrics, and manage your deployment from the Modelence Cloud dashboard.
self_host.note: Modelence Cloud (the hosting/deployment platform being modeled here) is a managed SaaS; there is no documented way to run the Cloud platform itself on your own infrastructure (the separate open-source npm framework can run anywhere, but that is local dev, not this hosted product).

byoc.quote: Enterprise ... Unlimited production instances, multi-region deployments, custom SLAs.
byoc.note: No bring-your-own-cloud-account deployment option is documented, even at the Enterprise tier.

open_source.quote: LICENSE.md: Apache License 2.0 — Copyright (c) 2025 Modelence, Inc.
open_source.note: The core `modelence` framework/npm package is Apache-2.0 licensed and open source on GitHub; the Modelence Cloud hosting service itself (billing, dashboard, App Builder) is proprietary SaaS built on top of it.

max_session_h.quote: There is no commitment - you only accrue charges while your deployment is running, on an hourly basis. You can immediately stop or adjust your environment at any time.
max_session_h.note: Production instances/containers run continuously until the user stops them; no maximum session duration is imposed.
